bio: Mimi's Bakehouse is family-run bakery overlooking the Water of Leith in the vibrant Shore area of Leith. Mimi's pride themselves on their sweet treats adopting the motto "it's all about the cake..." which sits proudly on the wall above their cake cabinet.  You can enjoy your Afternoon Tea in the cosy cafe, whilst taking a peak through the window into the bakery to see where the magic happens. The warm decor, friendly atmosphere and delicious food make Mimi's the perfect location for a catch up with friends or any special occasion!  Start off your Afternoon Tea experience with a selection of sandwiches made with classic fillings and warm, mini handmade sausage rolls. Follow this by enjoying warm scones, served with Mimi-made jam and thick clotted cream, then tucking in to a selection of the daily cakes and traybakes they offer. Enjoy all of this with a Teapigs tea or a cup of their triple certified, Glasgow roasted coffee. If you're after more of a cheeky treat, you can add a cocktail or glass of Champagne to your Afternoon Tea too!  Mimi's Bakehouse also offer vegetarian and gluten free versions of their Afternoon Tea.
